name: PiP Frame
description: Picture in picture: shrinks the clip into a framed box with rounded corners, a border and a drop shadow, placed anywhere in the frame.

params.name: position
params.description: Center of the box, 0..1 of the frame ([0, 0] = top-left)

params.name: scale
params.description: Box size, part of the frame

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius, part of the frame height

params.name: border
params.description: Border width, part of the frame height

params.name: shadow_offset
params.description: Shadow offset, part of the frame height
